quote: I went from copy-pasting Stack Overflow answers to actually understanding decorators well enough to write my own. Dana never let me move on until I could explain why, not just what.
Marcus's mock interviews were harder than my real ones. I walked into my onsite already calm because I'd done this exact whiteboard exercise three times.
The back-of-envelope estimation module alone was worth the price. I used it in an interview the following week.
Priya helped me connect my Python scripts to how they'd actually run in production. That context was missing from every course I'd tried before.
